title: Sick Leave Policy
description: Students may take up to 7 days of sick leave per semester with a medical certificate.

title: Casual Leave Policy
description: Students are allowed 5 days of casual leave per academic year without needing documentation.

title: Medical Emergency Leave
description: Extended leave can be granted in case of hospitalization with official medical records.

title: Family Emergency Leave
description: Students may request up to 10 days of leave for family emergencies with proper documentation.

title: Maternity Leave for Students
description: Pregnant students may take up to 90 days of maternity leave with valid documentation.

title: Paternity Leave
description: Male students are entitled to 5 days of paternity leave within 15 days of childbirth.

title: Religious Holiday Leave
description: Up to 3 days of leave are granted for religious observances upon written request.

title: Grievance Leave
description: Leave is granted for students facing psychological distress or personal loss, with counselor recommendation.

title: Leave for Sports Events
description: Students representing the school in sports can take leave for training and tournaments.

title: Leave for Cultural Events
description: Participants in cultural or inter-college events can request leave for event duration.

title: Study Leave Before Exams
description: Up to 5 days of study leave allowed before semester exams.

title: Internship Leave
description: Leave is granted for approved internships that coincide with academic breaks.

title: Research Leave
description: Students conducting external research can apply for research leave with approval.

title: Leave of Absence
description: A student can apply for a semester-long leave due to unavoidable circumstances.

title: Marriage Leave
description: Up to 7 days of leave can be granted for student marriage upon submission of invitation and proof.

title: Leave for Competitive Exams
description: Students preparing for competitive exams can apply for up to 3 days of leave before the exam.

title: Leave During Natural Disasters
description: Special leave may be granted during floods, earthquakes, or other calamities.

title: Leave for Volunteering Activities
description: Students involved in community service projects can apply for up to 4 days of leave.

title: Academic Conference Leave
description: Students presenting papers in conferences are allowed leave with proof of acceptance.

title: Leave for Visa or Passport Processing
description: Students applying for study abroad or internships may get 2 days leave for document processing.
